== Release date and foil checklist ==
The 25 May 2001 broadcast announces the following Wednesday as the release date. On Friday, 1 June, Decipher says the set came out two days earlier. See [https://archive.org/details/youtube-W-ktDatiJnM Radio Free Decipher #82] at 7:23 and [https://archive.org/details/youtube-rmNZWaAAPcg #83] at 1:01. The date for the retail set is 30 May 2001.

The [{{fullurl:Tatooine (expansion)|oldid=350504}} card list] links 21 Tatooine-origin foils from [https://web.archive.org/web/20030403064537id_/http://www2.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/r3cardlist.pdf Decipher’s Reflections III collector’s card list]. The 99 main checklist rows cover the 90 regular cards and nine alternate images.
